name: Genspark
tagline: An AI agent that researches a topic, then builds a finished result such as slides, a spreadsheet, a document or a website.
about: Genspark is a general-purpose AI agent. You describe the outcome you want and it plans the work, searches the web and produces a deliverable you can edit.
pros: One request can produce a complete slide deck, report or page.
cons: Results need checking before you share them.
